# A cube of blue chalk, 4 cm, left on the rail. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Chalk --base-color 0.1882 0.4392 0.6902 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Chalk --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.0200
scale 0.0400 0.0400 0.0400
apply --scale
material assign Chalk
select Chalk
active Chalk
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export chalk.glb
